+    where = params.get("where")

+    try:
+        tree = ast.parse(where, mode='eval')
+    except SyntaxError:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}
+
+    valid_nodes = (
+        ast.Expression, ast.Compare, ast.BoolOp, ast.UnaryOp,
+        ast.Constant, ast.Name,
+        ast.Eq, ast.NotEq, ast.Lt, ast.LtE, ast.Gt, ast.GtE,
+        ast.And, ast.Or, ast.Not,
+        ast.Load
+    )
+    
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if not isinstance(node, valid_nodes):
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}

+                return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}

+            return node.value
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+            return user[node.id]

+            left = evaluate(node.left, user)
+            op = node.ops[0]
+            right = evaluate(node.comparators[0], user)
+

+            if isinstance(op, ast.NotEq): return left != right
+            if isinstance(op, ast.Lt): return left < right
+            if isinstance(op, ast.LtE): return left <= right
+            if isinstance(op, ast.Gt): return left > right
+            if isinstance(op, ast.GtE): return left >= right
+            raise ValueError()
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+            values = [evaluate(v, user) for v in node.values]
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
+                return all(values)
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
+                return any(values)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
+                return not evaluate(node.operand, user)
+        raise ValueError()
+
+    filtered_users = []
